title: Layout precedent record
description: One accepted layout decision, kept with what it beat. The candidate shape is NOT restated here — it is referenced, so a change to the candidate schema cannot leave precedents describing a shape nobody produces any more.

project.description: A precedent is scoped to one project. It is never read into another product.

prompt.description: The business request that produced it.

hash.description: Of the canonical candidate only, never of a rendered page.

rejected.description: The part that earns the corpus its keep. Only the losers teach what to avoid.

why.description: One sentence on why it lost.

citedEntries.description: Checked against the current contract before this precedent is used. A cited key that no longer exists makes this record stale, not wrong.

status.description: `stale` is a citation problem. `overruled` is a wrong decision, superseded and kept so the reversal is readable. `non-general` marks a one-off surface: history without an invitation to reuse.

supersededBy.description: Required in spirit whenever status is `overruled`: a precedent is replaced, never deleted.
